description: This file defines a singleton class 'AppLifecycleLogger' responsible for logging application lifecycle events in a Windows app, including methods for different lifecycle stages and resizing events, with conditional diagnostic keyword constants.

classes.name: AppLifecycleLogger
classes.description: A singleton class that manages logging of app lifecycle events and resize events, utilizing Windows' logging channels and conditional diagnostic keywords.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of AppLifecycleLogger.

methods.name: GetTraceLoggingProviderEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the trace logging provider is enabled.

methods.name: LaunchUIResponsive
methods.description: Logs the event indicating the UI has become responsive after launch.

methods.name: LaunchVisibleComplete
methods.description: Logs the event indicating the app's launch is fully visible.

methods.name: ResumeUIResponsive
methods.description: Logs the event indicating the app has resumed and is responsive.

methods.name: ResumeVisibleComplete
methods.description: Logs the event indicating the app has resumed and is fully visible.

methods.name: ResizeUIResponsive
methods.description: Logs a resize event with the current view ID, indicating UI responsiveness.

methods.name: ResizeVisibleComplete
methods.description: Logs a resize event with the current view ID, indicating resize completion.

methods.name: ResizeUIResponsive
methods.description: Overloaded method that logs a resize event with a specified view ID.

methods.name: ResizeVisibleComplete
methods.description: Overloaded method that logs a resize complete event with a specified view ID.

methods.name: LogAppLifecycleEvent
methods.description: Internal method to log an app lifecycle event with specified fields.

methods.name: PopulateAppInfo
methods.description: Populates logging fields with app-specific information such as app ID, package name, and PSM key.
